name: The Strength of Corruption
summary: Talo Thornhoof, a hunter at Camp Mojache in Feralas, believes knowing an enemy well can turn a battle. Talo sends you to Felwood, north of Ashenvale, to face the fel-tainted bears and wolves and learn whether they have truly grown stronger.

sections.title: Know Your Enemy
sections.body: Talo Thornhoof is a hunter who strives to copy the strengths seen in opponents, and believes simply knowing an enemy well can turn a battle your way. Felwood lies north of Ashenvale, where a substance called fel has tainted the creatures. Talo thinks the bears and wolves there, driven mad by it, have also grown even stronger. Angerclaw grizzlies and Felpaw ravagers are the ones to face, twelve of each. Fel-touched things give off a strange green glow, which Talo senses is evil yet very powerful.

sections.title: What Talo Hears
sections.body: After your account of the beasts, Talo concludes they show a mindless ferocity, and warns you to stay alert and learn more of the corruption, since an enemy should always be known.

aliases: who gives the strength of corruption
faq.answer: Talo Thornhoof, a hunter at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

faq.q: Why does Talo Thornhoof want the beasts of Felwood faced?
aliases: why kill the bears and wolves
purpose of the strength of corruption
faq.answer: Talo believes that knowing an enemy well can turn a battle, and wants you to learn for yourself whether the fel-tainted creatures are truly as strong as believed.

faq.q: Which creatures are targeted in Felwood?
faq.answer: Angerclaw grizzlies and Felpaw ravagers in Felwood, twelve of each.

faq.q: What does Talo say about fel?
faq.answer: Everything touched by the fel gives off a strange green glow. Talo senses it is evil but also very powerful.
